lessons.trigger_cue: greet.js is stateful: first greet('ada') => hello, ada!, second => hi, ada!.
lessons.intervention: Design functions to be stateless when multiple outputs depend on input order, ensuring that each call can independently satisfy all requirements without conflict.
lessons.explanation: The validation failure stems from the stateful nature of greet.js, which leads to conflicting requirements for alternating greetings. The feedback indicates that the alternating criteria (AC2 and AC3) cannot be satisfied simultaneously due to the state being retained between calls, causing one criterion to always fail.
